阿拉伯语噪声中命令测试的验证及尽责性对测试表现影响的评估

Validation of the 'Arabic commands in noise test' and evaluation of the impact of conscientiousness on test performance.

中文摘要

本研究旨在验证新开发的噪声中言语（SiN）听力测试——阿拉伯语噪声中命令测试（ACINT），并探讨全局人格特质尽责性对听觉任务表现的影响。 该SiN测试在听力正常（NH）和听力受损（HI）个体中进行了两次。使用阿拉伯语NEO五因素量表（NEO-FFI），将听力正常个体根据其尽责性水平分为不同组别。 通过纯音测听确定，共纳入54名听力正常个体和20名轻度感音神经性听力损失个体。 不同尽责性水平的参与者之间未发现表现上的显著差异（F(1,52)=2.28，p = 0.14）。听力正常与听力受损参与者之间发现表现上的显著差异（F(1,72)=39.7，p < 0.001），听力受损组的测试分数信噪比（SNR）增加了4.14 dB。测试分数在多次测量中具有可重复性，Bland-Altman图中超过77%的数据位于一个标准差以内。 所开发的言语测试ACINT是一种有效且可重复的SiN测试，适合进一步的听力学研究。尽责性作为一种全局特质与听觉测试表现的改善无关。

英文摘要

This study aims to validate the newly developed speech-in-noise (SiN) hearing test, the Arabic commands in noise test (ACINT) and explore the effect of global personality trait conscientiousness on auditory task performance. The SiN test was performed twice on persons with normal hearing (NH) and hearing-impairment (HI). Using the Arabic NEO Five-Factor Inventory (NEO-FFI), individuals with NH were categorized into groups based on their level of conscientiousness. 54 normal hearing individuals and 20 individuals with mild sensorineural hearing loss as identified by pure tone audiometry. No significant difference in performance was found between participants with different conscientiousness levels (F(1,52)=2.28, p = 0.14). Significant differences in performance were found between NH and HI-impaired participants (F (1,72) =39.7, p < 0.001), with a 4.14 dB signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) increase in test scores for the HI group. The test scores were repeatable across measurements, with >77% of the data within one standard deviation in the Bland-Altman plots. The developed speech test, the ACINT, is a valid repeatable SiN test suitable for further audiological research. Conscientiousness as a global trait was not associated with improved auditory test performance.
